data: Tesla's net income fell from **$12,587 million in fiscal 2022 to $7,153 million in fiscal 2024**, a decline of $5,434 million, or about **43.2%**, according to its fiscal 2024 Form 10-K. Net income attributable to common stockholders, which excludes noncontrolling interests, fell by a similar amount, from $12,556 million to $7,091 million, a drop of about 43.5%. Fiscal 2023 was an outlier at $14,974 million because of a $5,001 million income tax benefit that year. The decline over the two years mainly reflects lower income from operations, which fell from $13,656 million in 2022 to $7,076 million in 2024 as gross profit shrank and operating expenses rose.
